title: ApiSigner.from_env refuses to run without a configured signing key
statement: ApiSigner.from_env raises ValueError when API_SIGNING_KEY_B64 (or the named variable) is unset or empty, instead of generating an ephemeral Ed25519 key. An ephemeral key is only made by calling ApiSigner() explicitly.
failure_mode: With the signing key unset, from_env silently generated a fresh key, so a misconfigured signer produced signatures no peer could verify instead of failing at startup. Two tests asserted the fallback as intended behaviour, so the suite protected the defect; they now assert the refusal.
